claim.claim-text: 1. A control box defining a lateral direction, a longitudinal direction, and a transverse direction, the control box comprising:
2. The control box of claim 1, wherein the circuit board is a system on module ("SOM") circuit board.

3. The control box of claim 1, wherein the circuit board is a first circuit board, and further comprising a second circuit board disposed within the interior, the second circuit board comprising the input/output connector.
4. The control box of claim 3, wherein the second circuit board further comprises a plurality of sensor connectors extending from the housing.
5. The control box of claim 1, wherein the heat sink comprises a base and a plurality of through-holes extending through the base along the transverse direction.
6. The control box of claim 5, wherein the heat sink further comprises a plurality of fins extending from the base.

7. The control box of claim 5, wherein the through-holes of the heat sink are arranged in a pattern, wherein the housing comprises a plurality of through-holes extending therethrough along the transverse direction and arranged in a pattern, and wherein the patterns of through-holes in the heat sink and housing are identical.
8. The control box of claim 1, wherein the heat sink is formed from a metal.

9. The control box of claim 1, wherein the heat sink comprises a base and a groove defined in the base, wherein a tab extends from the housing, and wherein the tab extends into the groove when the heat sink is connected to the housing.
